dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pwz6](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pwz6) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Mar 05 2025 26km N of Myothit. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 24.7433 longitude 94.4837. It impacted 353925 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
